name: (EXAMPLE) Gemeente
description: Fictional example set for a municipality, "Gemeente Esdoornstad": deep sea blue with a brown accent, from the approved dossiq portal mockups. Not a real organisation.
provenance: the palette of the approved portal-design mockups (portal.css .t-gemeente and .p-page), for a fictional organisation (example data, not a real brand)
_comment_source: A FICTIONAL set for demos and example data. No real municipality uses it.
Values marked "mockup" are quoted from portal.css of the approved portal-design mockups
(openspec/changes/example-gemeente-theme, design D1). Values marked "chosen" fill the ramp
steps the mockups leave open, under the rule the school sets follow: every step a component
can put text on, or under white text, reaches WCAG AA (4.5:1) against white: the 300 and
400 steps of each family, gray-500 and darker. gray-400 is the control border and reaches 3:1.
THE FONT IS ONE VALUE. typography.fontFamily becomes --nldesign-font-family, and every other
font token in this file reads that variable. Swapping Source Sans 3 for Fira Sans is a change
of that one string (an open decision for Ruben, see the change's tasks 0.1).

black.from: black; chosen, darker than the mockup ink

gray-400.from: gray-400; chosen, control border, 3.65:1 on white

blue-100.from: brand-100, mockup .t-gemeente --brand-tint (the role layer's brand family is its blue)

blue-200.from: brand-200, chosen, decorative tint (the role layer's brand family is its blue)

blue-300.from: brand-300, mockup .t-gemeente --brand, 8.80:1 on white (the role layer's brand family is its blue)

blue-400.from: brand-400, mockup .t-gemeente --brand-dark, 12.84:1 on white (the role layer's brand family is its blue)

blue-500.from: brand-500, chosen, 16.08:1 on white (the role layer's brand family is its blue)

pink-100.from: accent-100, chosen (the role layer's accent family is its pink)

pink-200.from: accent-200, chosen, decorative (the role layer's accent family is its pink)

pink-300.from: accent-300, mockup .t-gemeente --accent, 6.67:1 on white (the role layer's accent family is its pink)

pink-400.from: accent-400, chosen, 9.67:1 on white (the role layer's accent family is its pink)

#004488.from: brand-400: pagination text, the role layer hard-codes its own blue

#034591.from: brand-400: the role layer link blue

keepLiterals.#ffb612: role-layer focus and attention yellow, kept for a visible focus ring

--tilburg-interaction-color.reason: the role layer's link blue maps to brand-400, the hover step, so buttons and links wore #0B3648; the mockups draw them in --brand #12506B (example-gemeente-theme 4.2, seen live 10 Oct). Hover and active keep #0B3648

--tilburg-typography-font-family-primary.reason: the role layer names Avenir, which this app does not ship; the set font is bundled; follows --nldesign-font-family so a font swap is one value

--tilburg-typography-font-family-seconda.reason: same Avenir default as the primary family

--tilburg-navigation-font-family.reason: the role layer names Montserrat, which this app does not ship

--tilburg-focus-color.reason: the role layer pairs two mid blues here (1.7:1); a dark brand step on a light one reaches AA, and stays readable on a white page where no focus background is drawn

--tilburg-focus-background-color.reason: pairs with the dark focus colour above

--utrecht-alert-warning-color.reason: the role layer sets warning text in #ffb612 on #fffefa (1.7:1); the border keeps the yellow

--denhaag-step-marker-default-color.reason: the role layer puts white on gray-200 (1.3:1)

--denhaag-step-marker-not-checked-color.reason: gray-400 on white is a control-border step, not a text step

--denhaag-step-marker-disabled-color.reason: gray-400 on gray-100 stays under AA

--conduction-logo-header-background-imag.reason: the role layer bakes in a VNG mark; the logo must follow the token set

--conduction-logo-footer-background-imag.reason: same VNG mark in the footer band

--conduction-logo-navbar-background-imag.reason: same VNG mark in the navbar

typography.from: Source Sans 3 (OFL 1.1), bundled in css/fonts and css/systems/nldesign/fonts
